name: permissions
description: Retrieve effective permissions of given user/token.

params.name: path
params.description: Only dump this specific path, not the whole tree.

params.name: userid
params.description: User ID or full API token ID

permissions.description: Each user/token is allowed to dump their own permissions (or that of owned tokens). A user can dump the permissions of another user or their tokens if they have 'Sys.Audit' permission on /access.
